rulesTestNames: lets only the organizer's owner list its bill views
owner: Host read model projector: hostReadModels organizer bill view trigger
read: the organizer's current owner (ownerUserId, else the primary host) gets and lists (organizerId equality) while their account is not deleted
write: server only; written from each organizerBills document once it is sent, deleted with it
migrationNotes: bill equals what listOrganizerBills returns for the bill: no staff ids, reminders, history or link id, and the payment link only while unpaid. The host-organizer-bill-views copy-forward migration creates views for bills sent before the trigger.
listOrganizerBills was retired in Nov 2026 after the Host 1.0.6 floor raise (#2174); Host and the website billing portal read these views.
